design.emission: greedy ranked pixels, Euclidean minimum spacing, capped if a restricted domain cannot fit budget
design.scoring: DTI over every evaluated pixel in each guarded block; never masked by method-specific emission domain

promotion_gate.decision: NOT_PROMOTED; retain corrected H60 as local proxy anchor

scoring_domain_correction.issue: The old scripts/run_h60_screen.py passed each arm's restricted emission mask as the DTI valid mask. That removed proxy-truth cells outside the emission domain and failed to count those false negatives.
scoring_domain_correction.impact: Historical evidence/h60/screen.json, spacing-history.csv, selected-spacing floors, and H60-family rankings are emission-scoped and must not be described as full evaluated-map or official-metric assurance.
scoring_domain_correction.preservation: Historical files are unchanged; this screen is a new corrected-domain H60/H65 comparison.
scoring_domain_correction.correction: The runner now passes the full evaluated mask independently of the emitter mask and records both domain sizes.

conformal_scope.rank: k=ceil((21+1)*0.90)=20; finite-sample marginal level is at least 20/22 = 90.91% if block score vectors and one future block are exchangeable.
conformal_scope.target: one future guarded block's public-proxy DTI (or paired SGMC difference), not a mean, whole-map DTI, leaderboard score, private labels, or Phase 2 outcome
conformal_scope.assumptions: spatial blocking does not prove geological block exchangeability; H65 reuses blocks already examined in prior repository work, so H65 is exploratory and not a fresh confirmatory guarantee

block_reference_irregularity: The H65 preregistration cites evidence/h60/blocks.json, but that file is absent in this checkout. H60's own runner re-derives and asserts its frozen blocks against evidence/h50/blocks.json; this rerun uses that same H50 receipt and verifies all roles/budgets before scoring.

labels.provenance: owner-supplied mirror of a DrivenData competition file (login-walled at https://www.drivendata.org/competitions/306/competition-doe-gems/data/); integrity-pinned, NOT organizer-authenticated

sample_submission.provenance: owner-supplied mirror of a DrivenData competition file (login-walled at https://www.drivendata.org/competitions/306/competition-doe-gems/data/); integrity-pinned, NOT organizer-authenticated; used ONLY as the grid/footprint template (its 60,988 pixels equal to 1 sit on the labelled faults, unlike the page's 'total fault absence' wording)

ext_lidar_scarp_features_u8.provenance: derived by the owner's CI from USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM tiles (706 of 716 tiles; tile list OCR-recovered from the competition PDF); USGS 3DEP carries no use restrictions per the owner's receipt

ext_derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8.provenance: derived from USGS SGMC geologic-map faults (proxy only; not used in the factorial)

ext_tiger_road_distance_m.provenance: US Census TIGER road lines rasterised by the owner's CI to a per-cell distance (m) on the competition grid; noise mask for lidar scarp detection

ext_blm_closed_claim_distance_m.provenance: BLM closed mining-claim locations rasterised by the owner's CI to a per-cell distance (m) on the competition grid; noise mask for lidar scarp detection

limitations: Inputs are owner-mirrored and hash-pinned; not organizer-authenticated bytes.
The primary lappos peak proxy shares the owner-derived LiDAR modality with both fields and is circular/optimistic.
SGMC off-catalogue is a public geological-map proxy, not hidden competition truth; geological contact bias remains.
The corrected H60/H65 block comparisons are not scores on the competition leaderboard and do not validate the user-reported 0.3774 target.
No TIFF, portal upload, private-label query, weekly slot use, or final selection occurred.
